title: My Content » Media Manager
text:
## My Content » Media Manager
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000000876
The Media Manager helps keep all of the images and files being used by the Admin neatly stored in one place.
Within the Media Manager, the administrator can:
Upload Images & Files
Create Folders
Rename Images & Files
Delete Images & Files
IMPORTANT : When using Safari, the cookies must be enabled in the browser. Please see: Enable Cookies in Safari

## How To Upload Images & Files
Open My Content > Media Manager .
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12176443783/original/-0rfoE7wMQNNGz0qB7Si4A7zoveRoqSypg.png?1774366392 | alt: ]
Click Upload Image or PDF .
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12176443830/original/6uArjXfb_CBIX2cC8QDsjsg_x-wO03sd2A.png?1774366434 | alt: ]
Click anywhere within the upload box.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12132670574/original/aFatpnkCaNIdHkP7lJaTHb0IDEAI47IytQ.png?1697129338 | alt: ]
Select the image or file to upload and click Open .
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12096049320/original/EosSj0nVtA7mCro2myA1AbuH_oOEOYffZQ.png?1627394131 | alt: ]
Once the green check mark appears, click Back To All Media .

## Image & File Options
Hovering over an image reveals several options:
Download
Preview
Rename - How To Rename Images & Files From The Media Manager
Erase - How To Delete Images & Files From The Media Manager
Right clicking on an image will also reveal additional information:
FILE INFO includes:
Name
Dimensions
File Size
Date Uploaded
Copy URL
